entities.name: Juan Bautista Hernández Pérez
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Juan Bautista Hernández Pérez is a retired boxer from Cuba, who won the gold medal in the Bantamweight division (-54 kg) at age seventeen at the 1980 Summer Olympics in Moscow. In the final, he defeated Venezuela's Bernardo Piñango on points (5-0).
